But Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty soon start to heal the family and bring some light to Josie's complicated world.
tmdb_overview: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbors, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

synopsis: John Landis' cult horror classic returns to the Electric this Halloween. A huge wolf assaults Jack and David in Britain, leading to Jack's death. As David recovers in a hospital, he is tormented by nightmares of a mangled Jack warning him that he is becoming a werewolf...

synopsis: Bored with the same old scare-and-scream routine, Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King of Halloween Town, longs to spread the joy of Christmas. But his merry mission puts Santa in jeopardy and creates a nightmare for good little boys and girls everywhere!

Richard Avedon’s photographs didn’t just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon’s archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

synopsis: Viridiana
tmdb_overview: Viridiana is preparing to start her life as a nun when she is sent, somewhat unwillingly, to visit her aging uncle, Don Jaime. He supports her; but the two have met only once. Jaime thinks Viridiana resembles his dead wife. Viridiana has secretly despised this man all her life and finds her worst fears proven when Jaime grows determined to seduce his pure niece. Viridiana becomes undone as her uncle upends the plans she had made to join the convent.

synopsis: Rita Tushingham directed by Tony Richardson
tmdb_overview: While out to avoid spending time with her narcissistic and promiscuous mother, sixteen-year-old Jo has a brief affair that leaves her pregnant and abandoned. When her mother remarries, Jo's only support becomes her friend Geoffrey, a homosexual.

synopsis: Sophia Loren directed by Vittorio De Sica
tmdb_overview: Marco Tutino's opera, produced for the 2023 Wexford Festival Opera, tells the story of a mother and daughter fleeing the chaos and atrocities of the Second World War in Italy. It's a story inspired by Alberto Moravia's novel which was already adapted for the cinema by Vittorio De Sica in 1960, bagging Sophia Loren an Academy Award for her starring performance. La Ciociara, performed here on an Irish festival stage, offers a poignant operatic experience with powerful themes that resonate through time.

tmdb_overview: Keiko, whom everyone calls Mama, narrates her story: she's a hostess on the Ginza, 30, a widow. synopsis: Liela's Journey followed by director Q&A
tmdb_overview: Liela's Journey tells the deeply moving story of an elderly woman's harrowing escape from the devastating war in Sudan back to her home in England. Using her raw and intimate personal voice notes alongside a poignant original score, this documentary acts as a powerful testament to the human cost of conflict and a driving call to action to help Sudanese refugees.

synopsis:
Dracula (Cert TBC) & Short film
Genre: HorrorUK | 1958 | 83 minsDirector: Terence Fisher
Stars: Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee, Michael Gough

A landmark in English Gothic horror, Dracula made
Christopher Lee an international star, and caused major American distributors
to compete to release Hammer’s films. Elegant but shocking, this first colour
adaptation of Bram Stoker’s novel offered Lee’s physicality and seductive
menace, opposite Peter Cushing’s fearless Van Helsing. Now, following the
discovery of film elements in a Warner Bros. warehouse, a brand new restoration
brings the original uncut version (previously only seen in Japan in 1958) to UK
cinemas for the first time! Halloween screening, with support from Croydon
Council.
Plus
a short (10 mins) exploring the film’s restoration.

Pressure 
Genre(s): DramaUK/France/USA | 2026 | 100 minsDirector: Anthony Maras Stars: Andrew Scott, Brendan Fraser, Kerry Condon Our Thursday 22nd Oct 2pm screening contains captioned subtitles for those with hearing loss and a post-screening discussion facilitated by the Croydon u3a Film Group. Anyone is welcome to stay behind for a fun chat.Pressure tells the
remarkable untold story behind one of the most important decisions of the
Second World War. In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, Britain’s chief
meteorological officer, Captain James Stagg (Scott), must convince Allied
commanders, including General Eisenhower (Fraser), whether the weather will
allow the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history to proceed.
With the fate of millions hanging in the balance, this is a fascinating look at
the people, decisions and the uncertainty that helped shape the course of
history. Gripping, intelligent and led by a stellar cast.
tmdb_overview: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

synopsis:
The Cycle of Love 
Genre(s): Documentary/Biography/Action/Adventure/Sci-FiUK/India/Sweden/USA| 2025 | 98 minsDirector: Orlando von EinsiedeStars: PK Mahanandia, Anne-Charlotte von Schedvin, Mina
Dale
In 1975, 23-year-old PK Mahanandia
makes a living drawing portraits for tourists in Delhi when he meets Lotta
(Anne-Charlotte von Schedvin), a Swedish student visiting India. Convinced
their meeting is destiny, PK recalls a childhood prophecy that he would marry a
musical woman from a far-off country, born under the sign of the ox. After
spending time together, Lotta returns to Sweden, promising to come back once
her studies are complete. But when she doesn’t return as planned and PK cannot
afford a plane ticket, he sells everything he owns, buys a second-hand bicycle
and sets off on a 6,000-mile journey across continents to find her.



Based on an extraordinary true
story, The Cycle of Love is a heart-warming tale of love, destiny
and the courage to risk everything for the person you love. Blending
documentary interviews with dramatised scenes, it’s an epic journey that we
challenge you not to shed a tear for!
tmdb_overview: Explores the romantic journey of PK Mahanandia, a Delhi street artist who trekked 6,000 miles by bicycle in 1977, venturing across continents to reunite with the woman he loved.

synopsis:

In an isolated Tuscany valley, Adriano, a 50-year-old man haunted by a troubled past, lives alone in the renovated stables of a crumbling villa. Suddenly, a group of young idealists, led by Matilde, take over the empty villa, hoping to restore its long-abandoned vineyards. Though initially annoyed, Adriano gradually finds himself drawn to this lively community. But beneath the surface of this fragile harmony, old tensions and buried secrets begin to resurface. What is the heavy burden Adriano is trying so hard to conceal, and why does the manor awaken his darkest memories?

tmdb_overview: The Dashwood sisters, sensible Elinor and passionate Marianne, learn that their prospects of marriage seem doomed by their family's sudden loss of fortune. After Henry Dashwood dies unexpectedly, his estate must pass on by law to his son. These circumstances leave Mr. Dashwood's wife and daughters without a home and with barely enough money to live on. As Elinor and Marianne struggle to find romantic fulfillment in a society obsessed with financial and social status, they must learn to mix sense with sensibility in their dealings with both money and men.

synopsis: In an era of great change and great beauty emerged the character of James McNeill Whistler. Considered by some to be one of the great innovators of 19th century art, he was a contemporary of the Impressionists, much admired by Van Gogh and Manet. Boldly experimental and famously witty, Whistler disrupted the strict conventions of Victorian society in pursuit of a new cult of beauty, creating "art for art's sake" and earning himself a place in the history of great art. In 1983, Roald Dahl faces backlash over his antisemitic review of "God Cried" about West Beirut's siege during the 1982 Lebanon War. As he prepares "The Witches" for publication, he must choose: apologize or defend his words.
tmdb_overview: Set in the summer of 1983, just before the release of The Witches, Giant imagines a tense meeting between Roald Dahl and his American and British publishers as they scramble to contain the fallout from his public denunciation of Israel and defence of the Palestinians in a review of a book on the 1982 Lebanon war. Filmed live onstage at the Harold Pinter Theatre in London's West End in 2025.

tmdb_title: Second Nature: Gender and Sexuality in the Animal World
tmdb_original_title: Second Nature: Gender and Sexuality in the Animal World
tmdb_overview: Did you know that clownfish change sex from male to female? (So if Nemo’s mom had died in real life, his dad could have become his mom!) Did you know that albatross, penguins and swans parent in same sex pairs? Or that bonobos, who are just as closely related to us as chimps, are matriarchal and have same-sex sex every day?!  Narrated by Elliot Page, Second Nature follows trailblazing Evolutionary Biologist Dr. Joan Roughgarden as she meets groundbreaking scientists exploring the 1500+ animal species who engage in same-sex sexual behavior and parenting, change sex, form matriarchies, and more,  debunking myths that females are “inferior” and that being queer is “unnatural.”  SECOND NATURE — everything you didn’t learn in high school biology.

synopsis: FREE GIG: Scouts are a post-punk four-piece from South East London, blending noisy, atmospheric textures with the raw intensity of punk. Drawing from influences that range from post-punk to trip hop and shoegaze, their sound is restless and evolving, driven by experimentation and high-energy live performances. Known for their immersive, chaotic yet intimate performances across London, Scouts are set to release their debut single ‘Every Breath Means (I love you)’ this autumn.

A powerful documentary on how NDAs can be weaponised to silence, manipulate and control those who choose to speak out. Part of PRIFF 2026 , now in its fifth year, this special screening presents MY NDA , a documentary exploring how non-disclosure agreements can be used not simply to protect confidential information, but to silence people at moments of profound personal and professional vulnerability.

movie_title_en: Marcel the Shell with Shoes On (2022)
synopsis: Marcel is an adorable one-inch-tall shell who ekes out a colorful existence with his grandmother Connie and their pet lint, Alan. Once part of a sprawling community of shells, they now live alone as the sole survivors of a mysterious tragedy. When a documentarian discovers them amongst the clutter of his Airbnb, his resulting short film brings Marcel millions of passionate fans, as well as unprecedented dangers and a new hope at finding his long-lost family.

tmdb_overview: A mute noblewoman's vampiric heritage compels her to drain the life force from all of her lovers.

tmdb_overview: Diana Lorys, Collette Jack and Soledad Miranda star in this sexy thriller about two alluring dancers, Cincia and Anne, who embark on an erotically charged partnership. But when Anne starts to have nightmares that feature her as a murderous killer, she begins to lose her grip on reality. Or is reality merely rearing its ugly head in her dreams? She's determined find out what's causing this turmoil before something deadly happens.

tmdb_overview: Mr. Giant has kidnapped the brilliant Dr. Van Kohler and is planning to use the Doctor's invention, the N-bomb, to hold the world hostage. The only one who can foil Mr. Giant's evil scheme is Agent 00, a 3-foot-tall filipino martial arts master, expert marksman, top-class romancer and all-around superspy. Can Agent 00 rescue Dr. Kohler before it's too late?

Two teenagers escape a psychiatric hospital and turn the streets of New York into their stage. As the Sleez Sisters, Pamela and Nicky invent a noisy new identity that parents, police and respectable society cannot comfortably contain.Trini Alvarado and Robin Johnson give Allan Moyle’s cult film its bruised, rebellious heart. A tremendous punk and new-wave soundtrack propels a vision of friendship as self-invention, against a Midtown that has since disappeared. Ragged, romantic and fiercely attac
tmdb_overview: When a 13-year-old girl befriends a defiant antisocial child of the streets, the mismatched runaways set off to the Big Apple to find their own adventure.

synopsis: A pair of enchanted earrings offers Valerie protection as her village fills with vampires, corrupt holy men and relatives who will not stay in the same shape. tmdb_title: Valerie and Her Week of Wonders
tmdb_overview: Valerie, a Czechoslovakian teenager living with her grandmother, is blossoming into womanhood, but that transformation proves secondary to the effects she experiences when she puts on a pair of magic earrings. Now seeing the world around her in a different light, Valerie must endure her sexual awakening while attempting to discern reality from fantasy as she encounters lecherous priest Gracian, a vampire-like stranger and otherworldly carnival folk.

tmdb_overview: In this wildly entertaining vision of one of the twentieth century’s greatest artists, Bob Dylan is surrounded by teen fans, gets into heated philosophical jousts with journalists, and kicks back with fellow musicians Joan Baez, Donovan, and Alan Price.

His newest acquisition is a sculpture by Gilbert, whose wife Josée is captivated by Stanislas. But unbeknownst to her, Stanislas is amassing photographs of a very perverse, disturbed nature.

synopsis: Alice receives an obscene phone call so extraordinary that she falls in love with the caller. tmdb_overview: A sexually voracious young woman receives a dirty phone call from a stranger; so satisfied by the experience, she sets out to find him somewhere in New York City.

tmdb_overview: After a string of abusive relationships, Wanda abandons her family and seeks solace in the company of a petty criminal.

synopsis: Raised by a magician, a young man inherits a duty stranger than any ordinary family legacy: guarding La Goulve, the Daughter of the Golem. Sorcery, desire and the Golem legend make an unusual combination, promising a detour from familiar vampire and witchcraft stories
tmdb_overview: Axel, the magician, raises a boy into adulthood. When Axel dies, it's the young man - son of a murderer, and well tutored by a magician - to keep on the tradition of guarding the Daughter of the Golem.

tmdb_overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

The Dashwood sisters, sensible Elinor and passionate Marianne, learn that their prospects of marriage seem doomed by their family's sudden loss of fortune. After Henry Dashwood dies unexpectedly, his estate must pass on by law to his son. These circumstances leave Mr. Dashwood's wife and daughters without a home and with barely enough money to live on. As Elinor and Marianne struggle to find romantic fulfillment in a society obsessed with financial and social status, they must learn to mix sense with sensibility in their dealings with both money and men.

The Dashwood sisters, sensible Elinor and passionate Marianne, learn that their prospects of marriage seem doomed by their family's sudden loss of fortune. After Henry Dashwood dies unexpectedly, his estate must pass on by law to his son. These circumstances leave Mr. Dashwood's wife and daughters without a home and with barely enough money to live on. As Elinor and Marianne struggle to find romantic fulfillment in a society obsessed with financial and social status, they must learn to mix sense with sensibility in their dealings with both money and men.

tmdb_title: Royal Opera House: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
tmdb_original_title: Royal Opera House: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
tmdb_overview: A full-length ballet created by choreographer Christopher Wheeldon for the Royal Ballet at the Royal Opera House, Covent Garden. The ballet is based on Lewis Carroll's famous story of Alice, an ordinary girl who one summer afternoon falls down a rabbit hole and finds herself on an extraordinary adventure.  The music is by Joby Talbot, with designs by the internationally acclaimed Bob Crowley. Alice is danced by the Royal Ballet's Lauren Cuthbertson, and actor Simon Russell-Beale plays the cameo role of the Duchess.

synopsis: After moving to Salem, Mass., teenager Max Dennison explores an abandoned house with his sister Dani and their new friend, Allison. After dismissing a story Allison tells as superstitious, Max accidentally frees a coven of evil witches who used to live in the house. Now, with the help of a magical cat, the kids must steal the witches' book of spells to stop them from becoming immortal.

Mia is a free spirit who feels totally out of place in her picture-perfect hometown of Primrose. When her inquisitive nature causes one too many problems at school, Mia is sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy.

After discovering her new classmates are vampires, mummies, ghosts, werewolves and all other kinds of monsters, Mia starts to feel she’s finally found the place where she fits in… despite not being a monster herself. As she realises the monsters are afraid of humans as much as humans are monsters, Mia must find a way to bring the two worlds together before the wicked plans of her new headmaster, Van Vlad, cause disaster for all.
tmdb_overview: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.

synopsis:

synopsis:
Mia is a free spirit who feels totally out of place in her picture-perfect hometown of Primrose. When her inquisitive nature causes one too many problems at school, Mia is sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy.

After discovering her new classmates are vampires, mummies, ghosts, werewolves and all other kinds of monsters, Mia starts to feel she’s finally found the place where she fits in… despite not being a monster herself. As she realises the monsters are afraid of humans as much as humans are monsters, Mia must find a way to bring the two worlds together before the wicked plans of her new headmaster, Van Vlad, cause disaster for all.
tmdb_overview: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

synopsis:

synopsis:
While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. 

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.
tmdb_overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

synopsis:
After twenty years spent “chillin’, tokin’ and bonin’”, Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child’s very existence.

movie_title: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
movie_title_en: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…
tmdb_title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
tmdb_original_title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
tmdb_overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

synopsis: Based on the bestselling novel from Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro and written and directed by Academy-Award® winner Taika Waititi (Jojo Rabbit), Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams), and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.
tmdb_overview: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

movie_title: Unrestricted View Horror Film Festival 2026: Opening Night
movie_title_en: Unrestricted View Horror Film Festival 2026: Opening Night
synopsis:
UVHFF is back for its 11th year with another showcase of the very best in independent horror filmmaking. Our opening screening brings you a selection of outstanding UK horror shorts:

After Birth (Amy Cudden, UK)
Her baby breaks her nose, the house is in chaos, and she's a sleep-deprived mess. Ma's day couldn't get any worse... until she rips her face off in the sink. Finding a new one will hurt more than mastitis.

Grandma is Thirsty (Kris Carr, UK)
All George wants is to stop getting pushed around by the local bullies. So when a pair of weird twins offer to introduce him to their grandma — who can “make him big & strong” — he jumps at the chance.

The Humbug (Cole Paviour, UK)
Two elderly women in a care home grapple with magical mint humbugs, setting off an absurd journey through pleasure and peril.

Foreign Bodies (Lysander Wong, UK/Hong Kong)
A simple itch descends into an outbreak with many legs. Certain things will always find their way to the surface.

Homonym (Lily Howkins, UK)
Accused of murder, teenager Sam protests her innocence; claiming a malevolent presence in her family home is responsible. Unable or unwilling to accept her story, the police dismiss it. But as events take a sinister turn, they’re forced to reconsider.

Dissonance (Edward Zorab, UK)
Salomé, the orphan of a legendary musician, records at an infamous countryside studio. What begins as an opportunity to connect with her past soon takes a dark turn

A Hand to Hold (Philip Clyde-Smith, UK)
Moira, an elderly Irish woman, finds herself literally attached to her deceased husband Patrick. When his hand refuses to let go after death, it leads to increasingly grotesque events.

movie_title: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
movie_title_en: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…

movie_title: Toddler Club: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash-land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. 

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

synopsis: Based on the bestselling novel from Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro and written and directed by Academy-Award® winner Taika Waititi (Jojo Rabbit), Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams), and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.
tmdb_overview: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

movie_title_en: Toddler Club: We're Going on a Bear Hunt + The Tiger Who Came to Tea
synopsis:
Join us for a delightful double bill from Lupus Films as two beloved childhood classics come to life on the big screen. Perfect for little ones and nostalgic grown-ups alike, enjoy back-to-back screenings of We're Going on a Bear Hunt and The Tiger Who Came to Tea.

WE'RE GOING ON A BEAR HUNT
Follow the intrepid adventures of siblings Stan, Katie, Rosie, Max, the baby and Rufus the dog, who set off on an expedition in search of bears, determined to ‘catch a big one’.

synopsis:
Mia is a free spirit who feels totally out of place in her picture-perfect hometown of Primrose. When her inquisitive nature causes one too many problems at school, Mia is sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy.

After discovering her new classmates are vampires, mummies, ghosts, werewolves and all other kinds of monsters, Mia starts to feel she’s finally found the place where she fits in… despite not being a monster herself. As she realises the monsters are afraid of humans as much as humans are monsters, Mia must find a way to bring the two worlds together before the wicked plans of her new headmaster, Van Vlad, cause disaster for all.

But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

synopsis: At the height of the Cold War, Fatherland centers on the relationship between the writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika—actress, writer and rally driver—as they embark on a road trip in a black Buick cruiser across a Germany in ruins, from U.S. dominated Frankfurt to Soviet controlled Weimar.

The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

synopsis:
While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. 

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

synopsis: Based on the bestselling novel from Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro and written and directed by Academy-Award® winner Taika Waititi (Jojo Rabbit), Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams), and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.
tmdb_overview: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

synopsis: Based on the bestselling novel from Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro and written and directed by Academy-Award® winner Taika Waititi (Jojo Rabbit), Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams), and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.
tmdb_overview: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

synopsis:

synopsis:
A landmark in Gothic horror, Dracula cemented Hammer Films' reputation as the leading force in modern horror cinema and introduced audiences worldwide to Christopher Lee's definitive interpretation of Bram Stoker's immortal vampire. 

Opposite Peter Cushing's fearless Van Helsing, Lee brought a terrifying physicality and seductive menace to the role that would redefine the Count for generations. When Jonathan Harker arrives at a remote Transylvanian castle, he discovers that his mysterious host, Count Dracula, is a centuries-old vampire who feeds upon the blood of the living. 

As Dracula's reign of terror spreads across Europe, the determined Professor Van Helsing embarks on a desperate battle to destroy the Prince of Darkness before more innocent lives are claimed.

synopsis:
In the seedy underbelly of 18th-century Paris, money is king. Nothing is sacred – even love itself can be bought for the right price. A native of this hedonistic underworld, Manon is caught between twin desires when she falls in love with the student Des Grieux. Steadfast and devoted, he offers the possibility of an honourable life. Yet, the riches promised by the world of Parisian society remain tempting...

Manon’s inner turmoil and struggle for survival lie at the devastating heart of Kenneth MacMillan’s 1974 adaptation of Abbé Prévost’s novel. In this signature work of The Royal Ballet, MacMillan’s nuanced understanding of human psychology makes for an unflinching look into the moral degradation of Manon’s Paris, while all its decadence and decay are brought to life through Jules Massenet’s score and Nicholas Georgiadis’s designs.

movie_title: Soundtracking Film Club: Wild Horse Nine
movie_title_en: Soundtracking Film Club: Wild Horse Nine
synopsis:
PRESENTED BY RANGE ROVER
Join us at Everyman King's Cross on Tuesday, 27 October, for Soundtracking Film Club, in partnership with Range Rover, for a special screening of Wild Horse Nine. Across a series of 10 specially curated events, the partnership is formed around a shared belief in excellence, craftsmanship and the power of extraordinary experiences.

Following the film, Edith Bowman will be joined by director Martin McDonagh to discuss the making of Wild Horse Nine, sharing behind-the-scenes stories and insights from their experiences on set.

Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris (John Malkovich) and Lee (Sam Rockwell) are dispatched from Santiago to Easter island by their bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students (Mariana di Girolamo and Ailín Salas) threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

The story of a courageous girl, Prue McKeel, on a desperate mission to rescue her baby brother from a forbidden forest filled with enchanted creatures, endearing allies, and formidable adversaries. Her journey unfolds into a spectacular, high-stakes adventure where the fate of an entire hidden world hangs in the balance.
tmdb_overview: After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, Prue and her classmate Curtis stumble upon a secret world in the midst of violent upheaval—a world full of warring creatures, peaceable mystics, and powerful figures with dark intentions. And what begins as a rescue mission becomes something much greater as the two find themselves entwined in a struggle for the very freedom of this wilderness—a wilderness the locals call Wildwood

synopsis:
Michael Mann returns to Everyman Screen on the Green from 25 September to 24 October. Join us for a season dedicated to five unforgettable works from one of modern cinema's most influential filmmakers.

This week, we're screening 'Heat' in stunning 35mm. Michael Mann's legendary crime epic brings together Al Pacino and Robert De Niro in a thrilling cat-and-mouse battle between a dedicated LAPD detective and a master professional thief. Set against the sprawling backdrop of Los Angeles, Heat is a gripping story of obsession, loyalty and sacrifice, featuring some of the most electrifying action sequences ever committed to film.
A mysterious discovery is made on the outskirts of the remote harbor town. The residents find themselves in a desperate fight for survival against something they have never encountered before.
tmdb_overview: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

synopsis:
From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise.

In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
tmdb_overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

synopsis:
While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. 

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

synopsis:
Mia is a free spirit who feels totally out of place in her picture-perfect hometown of Primrose. When her inquisitive nature causes one too many problems at school, Mia is sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy.

After discovering her new classmates are vampires, mummies, ghosts, werewolves and all other kinds of monsters, Mia starts to feel she’s finally found the place where she fits in… despite not being a monster herself. As she realises the monsters are afraid of humans as much as humans are monsters, Mia must find a way to bring the two worlds together before the wicked plans of her new headmaster, Van Vlad, cause disaster for all.
tmdb_overview: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

movie_title: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
movie_title_en: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…

movie_title: Toddler Club: We're Going on a Bear Hunt + The Tiger Who Came to Tea
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: We're Going on a Bear Hunt + The Tiger Who Came to Tea
synopsis:
Join us for a delightful double bill from Lupus Films as two beloved childhood classics come to life on the big screen. Perfect for little ones and nostalgic grown-ups alike, enjoy back-to-back screenings of We're Going on a Bear Hunt and The Tiger Who Came to Tea.

WE'RE GOING ON A BEAR HUNT
Follow the intrepid adventures of siblings Stan, Katie, Rosie, Max, the baby and Rufus the dog, who set off on an expedition in search of bears, determined to ‘catch a big one’.

Based on the bestselling bedtime book, written by Michael Rosen and illustrated by Helen Oxenbury, We’re Going on a Bear Hunt is brought to life by the voices of Olivia Colman, Pam Ferris and Mark Williams.

THE TIGER WHO CAME TO TEA
A mysterious tiger turns up unannounced and invites himself in for afternoon tea. Young Sophie and her mummy watch in fascination as the tiger proceeds to eat not only their tea, but the entire contents of the fridge and everything else in the house!

Judith Kerr's beloved story is brought to life by the voices of David Oyelowo, Tamsin Grieg, Benedict Cumberbatch, David Walliams, Paul Whitehouse, and with music from Robbie Williams.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

As she realises the monsters are afraid of humans as much as humans are monsters, Mia must find a way to bring the two worlds together before the wicked plans of her new headmaster, Van Vlad, cause disaster for all.

But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

synopsis:

But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…

synopsis:
While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. 

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

synopsis:
After twenty years spent “chillin’, tokin’ and bonin’”, Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child’s very existence.

synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

synopsis: Based on the bestselling novel from Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro and written and directed by Academy-Award® winner Taika Waititi (Jojo Rabbit), Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams), and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.
tmdb_overview: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

synopsis: The story of a courageous girl, Prue McKeel, on a desperate mission to rescue her baby brother from a forbidden forest filled with enchanted creatures, endearing allies, and formidable adversaries. Her journey unfolds into a spectacular, high-stakes adventure where the fate of an entire hidden world hangs in the balance.
tmdb_overview: After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, Prue and her classmate Curtis stumble upon a secret world in the midst of violent upheaval—a world full of warring creatures, peaceable mystics, and powerful figures with dark intentions. movie_title: Ozzy & Black Sabbath: Back To The Beginning
movie_title_en: Ozzy & Black Sabbath: Back To The Beginning
synopsis:
OZZY & BLACK SABBATH: BACK TO THE BEGINNING documents a landmark moment in music history: Ozzy Osbourne’s historic final farewell performance for his fans at Villa Park stadium in his Birmingham hometown--captured just 17 days before his untimely passing. 

The film highlights the historic day with performances from Ozzy, Black Sabbath, and some of the most influential names in rock, along with personal reflections from the superstar musicians they inspired and a behind-the-scenes look at the day itself. This is an historic and intimate farewell to Ozzy and the band that changed music forever.

synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams), and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.
tmdb_overview: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

synopsis:
Mia is a free spirit who feels totally out of place in her picture-perfect hometown of Primrose. When her inquisitive nature causes one too many problems at school, Mia is sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy.

After discovering her new classmates are vampires, mummies, ghosts, werewolves and all other kinds of monsters, Mia starts to feel she’s finally found the place where she fits in… despite not being a monster herself. As she realises the monsters are afraid of humans as much as humans are monsters, Mia must find a way to bring the two worlds together before the wicked plans of her new headmaster, Van Vlad, cause disaster for all.
tmdb_overview: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

movie_title: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
movie_title_en: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
synopsis:
The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

When an amateur séance goes awry, Julian seizes the opportunity to leave the grounds in the body of teenage ghost hunter Jack. Whilst Julian experiences the outside world for the first time in decades, Jack gets a crash course in the afterlife from the ghosts. But what was supposed to be a temporary switch soon reveals the risk of permanent consequences…

movie_title: Ozzy & Black Sabbath: Back To The Beginning
movie_title_en: Ozzy & Black Sabbath: Back To The Beginning
synopsis:
OZZY & BLACK SABBATH: BACK TO THE BEGINNING documents a landmark moment in music history: Ozzy Osbourne’s historic final farewell performance for his fans at Villa Park stadium in his Birmingham hometown--captured just 17 days before his untimely passing. 

The film highlights the historic day with performances from Ozzy, Black Sabbath, and some of the most influential names in rock, along with personal reflections from the superstar musicians they inspired and a behind-the-scenes look at the day itself. This is an historic and intimate farewell to Ozzy and the band that changed music forever.

Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity’s husband, Jeremy.
tmdb_overview: Lowen Ashleigh is hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who is unable to finish following an accident. Lowen gradually uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

synopsis: The story of a courageous girl, Prue McKeel, on a desperate mission to rescue her baby brother from a forbidden forest filled with enchanted creatures, endearing allies, and formidable adversaries. Her journey unfolds into a spectacular, high-stakes adventure where the fate of an entire hidden world hangs in the balance.
tmdb_overview: After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, Prue and her classmate Curtis stumble upon a secret world in the midst of violent upheaval—a world full of warring creatures, peaceable mystics, and powerful figures with dark intentions. And what begins as a rescue mission becomes something much greater as the two find themselves entwined in a struggle for the very freedom of this wilderness—a wilderness the locals call Wildwood

synopsis:
Start your night right with a complimentary cocktail reception at 6PM. 
In collaboration with Hawksmoor - Seven Dials.

Everyman is proud to host Steven Soderbergh's A Man Under The Influence.

The series presents one film from each decade selected by Steven Soderbergh as a source of inspiration throughout his career. 

This week it's the 2000's; join us at Everyman at The Whiteley for Phantom Thread (2017) - Set in the glamour of 1950’s post-war London, renowned dressmaker Reynolds Woodcock and his sister Cyril are at the center of British fashion, dressing royalty, movie stars, heiresses, socialites, debutants and dames with the distinct style of The House of Woodcock. 

Each screening is complete with a 63-minute reception featuring Singani 63 cocktails created with some of London's leading bars and inspired by the night's film, alongside a playlist curated by the filmmaker himself, and an exclusive recorded introduction from Soderbergh.

synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

movie_title: Toddler Club: Tabby McTat + Room on the Broom
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: Tabby McTat + Room on the Broom
synopsis:
Join us for a Toddler Club double-bill, featuring Julia Donaldson's famous children's tales on the big screen!

TABBY MCTAT
Tabby McTat is a purrr-fectly happy busker's cat, until one day he falls in love with Sock, a gorgeous green-eyed cat. But when his busker Fred is hurt and taken away to hospital, Tabby can't find him and misses him terribly.

ROOM ON THE BROOM
The witch and her cat are happily flying through the sky on a broomstick when the wind picks up and blows away the witch's hat, then her bow, and then her wand!

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

synopsis: This documentary follows mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson as they attempt the perilous challenge of skiing the direct north face of Mount Everest.
tmdb_overview: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

synopsis:
An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, Ken Russell's The Devils is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption - and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. 

Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell's definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. Ken Russell's The Devils is the uncut and unfiltered theatrical experience that Russell always envisioned - and the first time the film will be presented restored and in 4k.

movie_title: After Dark: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
movie_title_en: After Dark: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
synopsis:
Step into the shadows and join us After Dark at Everyman Broadgate. This week, head into the heart of Camp Miasma and uncover the disturbing secrets of a cult horror franchise that refuses to stay on screen in Jane Schoenbrun’s surreal, genre-bending slasher, Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma.

After years of slapdash sequels, the Camp Miasma franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original’s star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

Welcome to Relaxed Screenings - a comfortable and inclusive way to enjoy the magic of the movies in a sensory and autism-friendly environment. Every month, we host a special screening with reduced volume, dimmed lighting, and no ads or trailers, creating a calm and stress-free setting for neurodiverse guests, including those with autism and sensory sensitivities, and their friends, family, and carers.

Join us Sunday, 1 November, for a relaxed screening of Forgotten Island. While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. 

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal, the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that their entire friendship is the price of returning home, Jo and Raissa race to find a way off the island before they forget each other forever.

BBFC Content Warning: Forgotten Island is rated PG with some threat, violence, injury detail, language, dangerous behaviour, rude humour. Please check the BBFC website for further information: https://www.bbfc.co.uk/release/forgotten-island-q29sbgvjdglvbjpwwc0xmteynzmz

movie_title: Toddler Club: Tabby McTat + Room on the Broom
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: Tabby McTat + Room on the Broom
synopsis:
Join us for a Toddler Club double-bill, featuring Julia Donaldson's famous children's tales on the big screen!

TABBY MCTAT
Tabby McTat is a purrr-fectly happy busker's cat, until one day he falls in love with Sock, a gorgeous green-eyed cat. But when his busker Fred is hurt and taken away to hospital, Tabby can't find him and misses him terribly.

ROOM ON THE BROOM
The witch and her cat are happily flying through the sky on a broomstick when the wind picks up and blows away the witch's hat, then her bow, and then her wand!

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

synopsis:
An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, Ken Russell's The Devils is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption - and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. 

Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell's definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. Ken Russell's The Devils is the uncut and unfiltered theatrical experience that Russell always envisioned - and the first time the film will be presented restored and in 4k.

synopsis:
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.
 
“Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
tmdb_overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

synopsis: Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity’s husband, Jeremy.
tmdb_overview: Lowen Ashleigh is hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who is unable to finish following an accident. Lowen gradually uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

movie_title: After Dark: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
movie_title_en: After Dark: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
synopsis:
Step into the shadows and join us After Dark at Everyman Broadgate. This week, head into the heart of Camp Miasma and uncover the disturbing secrets of a cult horror franchise that refuses to stay on screen in Jane Schoenbrun’s surreal, genre-bending slasher, Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma.

After years of slapdash sequels, the Camp Miasma franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original’s star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

Welcome to Relaxed Screenings - a comfortable and inclusive way to enjoy the magic of the movies in a sensory and autism-friendly environment. Every month, we host a special screening with reduced volume, dimmed lighting, and no ads or trailers, creating a calm and stress-free setting for neurodiverse guests, including those with autism and sensory sensitivities, and their friends, family, and carers.

Join us Sunday, 1 November, for a relaxed screening of Forgotten Island. While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. 

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal, the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that their entire friendship is the price of returning home, Jo and Raissa race to find a way off the island before they forget each other forever.

BBFC Content Warning: Forgotten Island is rated PG with some threat, violence, injury detail, language, dangerous behaviour, rude humour. Please check the BBFC website for further information: https://www.bbfc.co.uk/release/forgotten-island-q29sbgvjdglvbjpwwc0xmteynzmz

Before then, Donnie will navigate teenage life in suburbia while following Frank’s maladjusted instructions.

Screening on Sundays and Wednesdays as part of our Throwback Season, where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.
tmdb_overview: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a large bunny rabbit that manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

synopsis: In rural Ireland, amateur historian Catherine Corless (BAFTA-winner Monica Dolan) begins researching a former institution for unmarried mothers and their children in Tuam, County Galway and uncovers a shocking hidden history of neglect and loss. Faced with the deafening silence of church and state, she embarks on a campaign for justice, confronting deep wounds that continue to shape Ireland today.
tmdb_overview: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.

synopsis:
An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, Ken Russell's The Devils is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption - and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. 

Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell's definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. Ken Russell's The Devils is the uncut and unfiltered theatrical experience that Russell always envisioned - and the first time the film will be presented restored and in 4k.

synopsis:
Everyman Members are invited to join us on Monday, 2 November, for a preview screening of Martin McDonagh's Wild Horse Nine, a dark comedy set shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup.

CIA agents Chris (John Malkovich) and Lee (Sam Rockwell) are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students (Mariana di Girolamo and Ailín Salas) threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

synopsis:
In the seedy underbelly of 18th-century Paris, money is king. Nothing is sacred – even love itself can be bought for the right price. A native of this hedonistic underworld, Manon is caught between twin desires when she falls in love with the student Des Grieux. Steadfast and devoted, he offers the possibility of an honourable life. Yet, the riches promised by the world of Parisian society remain tempting...

Manon’s inner turmoil and struggle for survival lie at the devastating heart of Kenneth MacMillan’s 1974 adaptation of Abbé Prévost’s novel. In this signature work of The Royal Ballet, MacMillan’s nuanced understanding of human psychology makes for an unflinching look into the moral degradation of Manon’s Paris, while all its decadence and decay are brought to life through Jules Massenet’s score and Nicholas Georgiadis’s designs.

In rural Ireland, amateur historian Catherine Corless (BAFTA-winner Monica Dolan) begins researching a former institution for unmarried mothers and their children in Tuam, County Galway and uncovers a shocking hidden history of neglect and loss. Faced with the deafening silence of church and state, she embarks on a campaign for justice, confronting deep wounds that continue to shape Ireland today.
tmdb_overview: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.

synopsis:
Donnie is a troubled high school student: in therapy, prone to sleepwalking and in possession of an imaginary friend, a six-foot rabbit named Frank who predicts the imminent end of the world. Before then, Donnie will navigate teenage life in suburbia while following Frank’s maladjusted instructions.

synopsis:
An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, Ken Russell's The Devils is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption - and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. 

Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell's definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. Ken Russell's The Devils is the uncut and unfiltered theatrical experience that Russell always envisioned - and the first time the film will be presented restored and in 4k.

movie_title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend (Directors Cut)
movie_title_en: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend (Directors Cut)
synopsis:
An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

Please note that this screening includes a 15-minute interval.

Josh O’Connor (The Crown; Challengers) leads the cast in this searing revival of Clifford Odets’ knockout American classic. 

1930s New York, at the height of the Depression. Joe Bonaparte is a gifted young violinist with a future in music, until a chance at fame and fortune lures him into the brutal world of professional boxing. He must confront what he’s willing to sacrifice, who he’s willing to become and how to find his place in a world that demands he choose a side. 

Brought to life with a live string quartet and filmed live from the Almeida Theatre. Olivier Award-winner Sam Yates (Vanya) directs this propulsive drama exploring ambition, identity, and the high price of success.

movie_title: Toddler Club: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
synopsis:
On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

synopsis: Restored concert film featuring George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour performances at Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy, captured on 35mm over two nights during the European leg of the tour.
tmdb_overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

synopsis: Restored concert film featuring George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour performances at Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy, captured on 35mm over two nights during the European leg of the tour.

synopsis:
Step into the shadows and join us After Dark at Everyman Broadgate. This week, we're switching off the colour and hitting the streets of Paris with Mathieu Kassovitz's violently powerful and provocative La Haine.

When a young Arab is arrested and beaten unconscious by police, a riot erupts in the notoriously violent suburbs outside of Paris. Three of the victim's peers, Vinz (Vincent Cassel), Said (Said Taghmaoui) and Hubert (Hubert Koundé), wander aimlessly about their home turf in the aftermath of the violence as they try to come to grips with their outrage over the brutal incident. After one of the men finds a police officer's discarded weapon, their night seems poised to take a bleak turn.
